summary: FG Merger II Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing a material definitive agreement for an OTC Equity Prepaid Forward Transaction with Atsion Opportunity Fund LLC Series 2, partially novated to affiliate FG Capital Partners LLC. The seller intends but is not obligated to buy up to 3,000,000 shares of FGMC common stock pre-closing of the business combination with BOXABL Inc. The prepayment amount equals shares times per-share redemption price from trust. This provides potential growth capital replacing redeemed trust assets, not minimum cash. Watch for shareholder vote and redemption levels.
